newsitem.title: USA: Fla. woman allegedly offered to sell niece for $24.
newsitem.headline: Fla. woman allegedly offered to sell niece for $24.

text.p: Police have arrested a 26-year-old woman on charges she tried to sell her 5-year-old niece for $24 to pay for drinks and a ride home, police said on Monday.
The aunt, Jennifer Burroughs, was charged with the unlawful sale of a child, a felony. The child, Nicole Mezyk, was discovered sitting outside the Gaslight Lounge around midnight Friday, police said.
"It really upset me," Christina Blair, who found the child, told Reuters on Monday. "I've got two daughters of my own. I just can't imagine them like that."

Blair said she tried to find Nicole's mother but instead found Burroughs, her aunt, drinking a beer. Blair told police Burroughs said she and the child had not eaten for four days and she did not know where the mother was.
She offered to sell the girl to Blair for $20 plus $4 cab fare, police said. Authorities said the child's mother, Rhonda Mezyk, had left her daughter with Burroughs for the weekend.
